ऐणेयजङ्घ: aiṇeya-jaṅgha(-tā), (state of) having legs like a black antelope (= the more usual eṇeya°, q.v. under eṇī-): Mvy 267; Dharmas 83 (text aineya°); Gv 400.6 °gha-tā, glossed in 7 eṇeyasyeva mṛgarājño (indicating that aiṇ° is adj., eṇ° noun).
ऐन्द्रमार्ग: aindramārga (m.), lit. path of Indra = the open air: °ge Mv ii.157.7. See s.v. ajina-khipa.
ऐरावत: Airāvata, m., n. of a mountain (= next; occurs as n. of several mountains in Brahmanical and Jain Skt., see Kirfel, Kosm., Index s.v.): Divy 450.11.
ऐरावती: Airāvatī, n. of a yoginī: Sādh 427.5.
ऐर्यापथ: airyāpatha, m., = īryāpatha, q.v., in mg. 3, proper deportment; the form with vṛddhi of first syllable is not recorded elsewhere but seems guaranteed by LV 127.9, in the Bodhisattva's spelling lesson, where the letter ai stands for airyāpathaḥ (so prob. read, Lefm. °patha- with ms. A, other mss. airapathaḥ) śreyān; LV 191.16, text with most mss. prāsādikenairyāpathena (one ms. °kena iryyā°) saṃpannaṃ (bhikṣum); ŚsP 96.7 sarvasattvān airyāpatha-sahagate puṇyakriyāvastuni pratiṣṭhāpayitu-kāmena (bodhisattvena).
ऐषिका: aiṣikā (= Pali esikā; proverbially ‘stable, firm’, see refs. in PTSD), pillar (as that which makes firm, stead-fast): Śikṣ 3.7 (vs) niśraya (separate!) kleśa-adharṣika-tāyai aiṣika (m.c. for °kā; possibly read eṣika?) śraddha svayaṃbhuguṇānām, faith is a support, so as not to be subject to attack by the depravities, a pillar for the excellent qualities of the Self-existent. (Bendall and Rouse wrongly derive from eṣaka, to eṣati.)
ऐहिपश्यिक: aihipaśyika, adj., = ehipaśyika, q.v.; ep. of dharma: Mvy 1296; Śikṣ 323.6.
